name: LMArena arena-human-preference-55k (aggregate win counts by task code)
raw_sha256_note: Equals the X-Linked-ETag the Hugging Face hub reports for train.csv at this revision.
license_note: The dataset card at this revision declares license: apache-2.0. Only derived aggregate counts (battles, wins, losses, ties per task code and model) are redistributed here, with this attribution. No prompts, responses or battle ids are included. Citation: Chiang et al., 'Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference', arXiv:2403.04132.
derivation: Each battle's prompt is classified locally with the collector's rules-v1 classifier (in memory only). Every model in the battle adds one battle and a win, loss or tie to the cells (L1, L2, model), (L1, all L2) and (all tasks). win_rate = (wins + ties/2) / battles. Both tie labels count as ties.
